description: Machine-readable German-language style indicators for triage. These indicators can suggest uniform, formulaic, or generated-looking prose, but they do not prove AI authorship.

indicators.rationale: AI-generated prose can have more uniform sentence lengths than human prose. This is genre-dependent.
indicators.false_positive_note: Can trigger on manuals, legal text, press releases, educational material, or edited corporate style.

indicators.rationale: Low vocabulary variety and high repetition can indicate templated or generated text.
indicators.false_positive_note: Can trigger on repetitive technical documentation, product pages, legal notices, and SEO texts.

indicators.rationale: Dense use of neutral transitions and connective phrases is common in polished assistant-style German prose.
regex: \b(?:zudem|darüber hinaus|des weiteren|des Weiteren|ferner|außerdem|abschließend|zusammenfassend|insgesamt|grundsätzlich|in diesem zusammenhang|vor diesem hintergrund|nicht zuletzt|letztlich|somit|folglich|daher|demnach)\b
indicators.false_positive_note: Can be normal in governmental, academic, or explanatory prose.

indicators.rationale: Assistant-like caveats and advisory phrases can be weak indicators when clustered.
indicators.false_positive_note: Can be normal in careful expert writing.

indicators.rationale: Repeated parallel structures and triplets can make text sound template-like.
indicators.false_positive_note: Triplets and parallelism are normal rhetorical devices. Only density matters.

indicators.rationale: Informal German often contains fillers and colloquial markers. Absence should only be interpreted when genre metadata says the text should be informal.
indicators.false_positive_note: Do not flag formal or edited texts merely because they lack fillers.

indicators.rationale: High en/em dash density can be an assistant-style marker in some contexts, but is weak evidence only.
indicators.false_positive_note: Can be a deliberate human punctuation style.

indicators.rationale: Repeated n-grams indicate templating, copy-paste, or repetitive generation.
indicators.false_positive_note: Can trigger on structured lists, repeated product names, legal boilerplate, or API documentation.
